title: Bot HQ: Per-Bot Serial Turn Queue & Bounded Hop-Depth Guard
summary: Turns are serialized per botId via chained promises. New user messages expire pending tool approvals, markSilent() suppresses closing prose after ask_user, and bot-to-bot messaging enforces a strict hop-depth cap of 3 to prevent ping-pong loops.
